Record Class Project

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.jsonschema.generator.ref.Project
Record Components:
Title - Descriptive title of the professional experience. Cannot be blank
From - Project start date. It must be equals or before the end date
Persons - People involved in the project (without including yourself). Must be greater than zero
Type - Project kind, i.e.: Web Application, Mobile Application, REST service, CLI, etc
To - Finish date of the project. Should be set to a date equals or before today
Summary - Brief description of the project. If set, blank values aren't allowed
Client - Third party for which the project was developed. If set can not be blank
Highlights - Remarkable items achieved on this project. Empty text is not allowed
Roles - Set of roles played on the project. Blank items are not allowed
Skills - Skills used in the development of the project. Empty texts are not allowed
public record Project(@NotNull String Title, String Website, @Pattern(regexp="\\d{4}-\\d{2}") String From, float Persons, String Type, @Pattern(regexp="\\d{4}-\\d{2}") String To, String Summary, NullableOrganization Client, Boolean Production, Set<String> Highlights, Set<String> Roles, Set<String> Skills) extends Record

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
